_note: Single source of truth for the website roadmap section (index.html, between the roadmap markers) and the 'What features are coming soon?' help answer (docs/help/18). Edit here, then run: npm run build:roadmap && npm run build:support-kb. No dates, ever. 'match' lists lowercase phrases used by verify:roadmap to tie each 'Coming soon' pill on the site to an item here.
